name: gamenet_get_status_bit_name_tags
description: GameNet::GetStatusBitNameTags returns the global multiplayer name-tag status bit set by GameNet::SetStatusBitsFromFlags.
known_limits: Binary Ninja assembly inspection in the current session verified a cdecl no-argument accessor that loads and returns g_GameNetStatus_NameTags at 0x4f3f90.
The native GameNet status smoke verifies SetStatusBitsFromFlags drives GetStatusBitNameTags for both set and cleared name-tag states.
No VC manifest covers 0x433740 yet; tier S verification is deferred to a GameNet source-cluster pass.
